title: مِيمُ الْجَمْعِ II
titleEn: Harakah on ه and م in هم (Mīm al-jam II)
description: Rules regarding the the harakah to be read on the ه and م in word هم. Depending on the harakah before/after this word the qurra have differences in how they will recite it

dhammah_dhammah_preceeded_by_fath.title: Ḍhammah on the ه and م when preceeded by ḍammah, fatḥah or sukūn before هم.
dhammah_dhammah_preceeded_by_fath.description: When هم is preceeded by ḍammah, fatḥah or sukūn all of the qurra will read both the ه and م  with a ḍammah, whether in waṣl or waqf. And if after the هم there is a sakin the qurra will recite with ḍammah on both letters and no ṣilah (see rules for ṣilah in previous chapter)

kasrah_sukoon_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya.title: Kasrah on the ه when preceeded by kasrah or yāʾ sākinah in waqf
kasrah_sukoon_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya.description: When making waqf (ie stopping on هم) and the word هم is preceeded by a kasrah or yāʾ sākinah all of the qurra with recite the ه with a kasrah.
exceptions: Imam Hamza recites the words إليهم, لديهم, عليهم with a dhammah wherever they occur (see the rule of 'Ilay-hum, Laday-hum, 'Alay-hum' in the chapter of al-Fatiha

kasrah_kasrah_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.title: Kasrah on the ه and م when preceeded by kasrah or yāʾ sākinah and also followed by a sakin letter in wasl
kasrah_kasrah_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.description: When making wasl (ie continuing on and not stopping on هم) and the word هم is preceeded by a kasrah or yāʾ sākinah while also followed by a sakin letter Imam Abu Amr will recite both the ه and م with a kasrah.

examples.verse: examples of mīm al-jamʿ for imam abu-amr when preceeded by kasrah/ya and followed by sakin

dhamma_dhamma_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.title: Ḍhammah on the ه and م when preceeded by kasrah or yāʾ sākinah and also followed by a sakin letter in wasl
dhamma_dhamma_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.description: When making wasl (ie continuing on and not stopping on هم) and the word هم is preceeded by a kasrah or yāʾ sākinah while also followed by a sakin letter Imams Hamza & Kisai will recite both the ه and م with a ḍammah.

examples.verse: examples of mīm al-jamʿ for imam hamza/kisai when preceeded by kasrah/ya and followed by sakin

kasrah_dhamma_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.title: Kasrah on the ه and Ḍhammah on the م when preceeded by kasrah or yāʾ sākinah and also followed by a sakin letter in wasl
kasrah_dhamma_preceeded_by_kasrah_ya_was.description: When making wasl (ie continuing on and not stopping on هم) and the word هم is preceeded by a kasrah or yāʾ sākinah while also followed by a sakin letter the remaining qurra will recite a kasrah on the ه and ḍammah on the م.

examples.verse: examples of mīm al-jamʿ for remainder when preceeded by kasrah/ya and followed by sakin
